sources.title: UW Film Study: Iowa Hawkeyes
sources.description: The Washington Huskies returned to Husky Stadium for this year’s rendition of Friday Night Lights. However the team did not show up to play, as they got routed by the Iowa Hawkeyes 41-24. The offense was stagnant out of the gates yet again, while the defense finally collapsed after being the team’s lifeline during the […]
